title: WaitlistCommandsReconcileAcceptV1
description: Queue-only command (spec 11 §5.1) crossing the broker to the waitlist consumer (consumer 'waitlist.processor'). Scheduled with a delay by accept/auto-accept when the Offered->Accepted claim was LOST to a concurrent expire/decline AFTER the booking was already minted through spec 04. The handler probes the minted operation's real outcome and settles the divergence: if the operation booked, the enrollment is marked terminal (fulfilled) so it is never re-offered (no double-book); if it terminally failed, nothing was booked so the enrollee stays eligible; if still in-flight, a bounded re-check is scheduled. Carries NO secrets or PII beyond opaque ids (Inv-12).

message_type.description: Explicit schema discriminator; always 'waitlist.commands.reconcile_accept.v1' for this contract.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope. All consumer-side writes are scoped to this tenant (Inv-13).

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier propagated across the waitlist chain (typically the enrollment id).

causation_id.description: message_id of the direct cause (the accept whose claim was lost).

offer_id.description: Stable id of the waitlist_offers row whose accept lost the claim after minting.

operation_id.description: Booking operation minted by the accept; the handler probes its terminal status.

enrollment_id.description: Enrollment the offer belonged to; marked terminal (fulfilled) if the operation booked.

attempt.description: Zero-based probe attempt; bounds the re-check when the operation is still in-flight.
